cohort: 1,794 mother-neonate dyads from the Generation C Study in NYC with known prenatal COVID-19 vaccination status
finding: Prenatal COVID-19 vaccination was not associated with adverse delivery or neonatal outcomes, including birthweight, gestational age, blood loss, Caesarean delivery, or NICU admission.
mod_finding: The study found no association between prenatal COVID-19 vaccination and adverse delivery outcomes, including Cesarean delivery.
